source_priority_note: FSSAI compiled FSSR PDFs supply product identity/quality excerpts; original notified operative Gazette and effective amendments prevail in case of discrepancy. Even exact published product standard is not equivalent to proof of actual commercial formulation or CTR article/limit.

critical_findings.false_analogy: Do not transfer packaged water lead table to vending water just from water category.
Neither fully dairy-free assumption nor ordinary milk powder lead limit is supported.
No cocoa powder dry fat-free CTR limit from botanical origin alone.
No higher-than-1% sulphated-ash comparator for a conforming lot.
No refined sugar chromium CTR transfer from candy crystal identity.
No lead PASS or lead threshold from silver fineness.

case_dossiers.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Vended purified drinking water is expressly distinct from packaged drinking water or mineral water; IS:10500 is referenced.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Do not transpose packaged-water table lead maximum solely because both are drinking water.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Confirm vending mechanism, dispensing sample outlet, sale state and current notified treatment under IS:10500.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need sale format (dispensed cup/bottle), water source, whether item is legally packaged drinking water and sample taken from tap/outlet.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Do not transpose packaged-water table lead maximum solely because both are drinking water.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Confirm vending mechanism, dispensing sample outlet, sale state and current notified treatment under IS:10500.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Coffee-chicory mixture of roasted ground forms requires coffee at least 51% by mass; instant and decaffeinated variants have separate descriptions.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Do not infer a coffee-only ochratoxin CTR threshold applies to the finished blend.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain percentage of coffee/chicory, standard versus instant/decaffeinated variant and market label.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need actual coffee/chicory percentages, roasted or soluble form and signed applicability of coffee OTA article to final blend.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Do not infer a coffee-only ochratoxin CTR threshold applies to the finished blend.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain percentage of coffee/chicory, standard versus instant/decaffeinated variant and market label.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need target age range, product label, FSMP/FSDU status, manufacturer designation and ready-to-use versus powder basis.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need target age range, product label, FSMP/FSDU status, manufacturer designation and ready-to-use versus powder basis.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Age, intended use and final product class must be established first; 09.006 measures chromium, not the current lead comparator, and infant-formula category does not automatically follow.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need fruit species, specific crop pesticide(s), fresh/frozen/processed status and pesticide-specific commodity MRL; shell-free eggs row shown as a contrasting example only.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need fruit species, specific crop pesticide(s), fresh/frozen/processed status and pesticide-specific commodity MRL; shell-free eggs row shown as a contrasting example only.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: No target chemical identified: first determine residue family and substance before selecting any method, MRL or screening assay.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Catechu (edible) is dried aqueous extract of Acacia catechu heartwood with own identity and quality criteria.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: A plant extract is not automatically a chemical-additives or generic chemical category for lead.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain plant source, actual extraction preparation, commercial designation and supplier specification.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need exact edible catechu species/process, whether pure ingredient/extract vs chemical additive; 'chemicals other' not presumed.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: A plant extract is not automatically a chemical-additives or generic chemical category for lead.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain plant source, actual extraction preparation, commercial designation and supplier specification.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Seedless tamarind comes from mature ripe Tamarindus indica fruit after removing outer cover and seeds; FSSR separately states moisture and ash quality criteria.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Seedless tamarind fruit flesh is not automatically commercially manufactured pulp, puree or concentrate for copper CTR.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Get as-sold whole/flesh form, water percentage, added ingredients and preparation steps.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need to know whole deseeded pulp flesh vs manufactured fruit pulp, water content, salt/preservative additions and origin.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Seedless tamarind fruit flesh is not automatically commercially manufactured pulp, puree or concentrate for copper CTR.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Get as-sold whole/flesh form, water percentage, added ingredients and preparation steps.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Coconut milk powder is spray-dried/dehydrated coconut milk; maltodextrin AND sodium caseinate may be added; fat at least 60% on dry basis.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Coconut-labelled powder is not automatically free of dairy protein and not the regulated ordinary milk/dairy-milk-powder CTR article.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain complete formulation including added caseinate, measured fat %, label/allergen and method matrix declaration.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need coconut vs dairy protein/fat sources, dehydration concentration factor and registered category; non-dairy coconut powder is not ordinary milk.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Coconut-labelled powder is not automatically free of dairy protein and not the regulated ordinary milk/dairy-milk-powder CTR article.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain complete formulation including added caseinate, measured fat %, label/allergen and method matrix declaration.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Cocoa beans are properly fermented and dried whole seeds of Theobroma cacao.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Do not infer cocoa powder (dry fat-free) or chocolate liquor lead maximum applies to fermented whole beans.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Prove whole-bean status, bean prep/grading, drying, presence of shells and raw/roasted sample basis.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need beans raw/roasted whole or nibs, fat and moisture; powder-specific dry fat-free metal basis not transferred.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Do not infer cocoa powder (dry fat-free) or chocolate liquor lead maximum applies to fermented whole beans.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Prove whole-bean status, bean prep/grading, drying, presence of shells and raw/roasted sample basis.

case_dossiers.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need cocoa solids%, sugar%, fat%, packing state and whether finished mix can legally be read as cocoa powder.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need cocoa solids%, sugar%, fat%, packing state and whether finished mix can legally be read as cocoa powder.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Complete cocoa/sugar/fat proportion and as-sold moisture basis required before interpreting 09.001 fat exclusion or dry fat-free basis.

case_dossiers.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need cocoa mass/liquor vs press cake vs de-oiled powder, fat% and dry/fat-free conversion method.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need cocoa mass/liquor vs press cake vs de-oiled powder, fat% and dry/fat-free conversion method.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Determine cocoa mass/liquor versus cocoa cake and actual fat %. 09.001 cannot be used if >=40% fat; no cocoa-powder contaminant row transferred.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need botanical chia identity and use; cereal grain label does not make Salvia hispanica a cereal.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need botanical chia identity and use; cereal grain label does not make Salvia hispanica a cereal.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Confirm target element, actual matrix and legal reporting basis. For lead review 09.005 and 09.001 scope/approx capability; no lab method assumed.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Carob powder is obtained from roasted pods of Ceratonia siliqua and has its own quality specification.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Roasted carob powder is not cocoa powder for CTR lead purposes.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Get botanical declaration, roast/milling procedure and absence/presence of cocoa blends.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need carob botanical source, powder composition; bean/seed powder is not cocoa powder.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Roasted carob powder is not cocoa powder for CTR lead purposes.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need botanical root source, milled starch vs grain origin; relevant named pesticide and processed-starch residue interpretation.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need botanical root source, milled starch vs grain origin; relevant named pesticide and processed-starch residue interpretation.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Name each pesticide and residue definition, actual commodity, validated GC-MS or LC-MS method and individual MRL; broad 'pesticide residues' is not one measured analyte.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Water chestnut flour is ground dried nuts of Trapa bispinosa or T. quadrispinosa.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Flour/atta naming does not make this botanical seed a cereal grain for lead CTR.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Get botanical identity, milling form, flour lot and adulterant/cereal composition.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need botanical water chestnut source and dried flour basis; word atta does not establish cereal grain identity.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Flour/atta naming does not make this botanical seed a cereal grain for lead CTR.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Get botanical identity, milling form, flour lot and adulterant/cereal composition.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need species, intestinal versus muscle tissue and processing brine; meat fat row cannot be assigned solely on animal source.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need species, intestinal versus muscle tissue and processing brine; meat fat row cannot be assigned solely on animal source.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Confirm target element, actual matrix and legal reporting basis. For lead review 09.005 and 09.001 scope/approx capability; no lab method assumed.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need pesticide identity, whole egg or yolk/white, dryer concentration ratio and whether shell-free-basis correction is legally required.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need pesticide identity, whole egg or yolk/white, dryer concentration ratio and whether shell-free-basis correction is legally required.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Name each pesticide and residue definition, actual commodity, validated GC-MS or LC-MS method and individual MRL; broad 'pesticide residues' is not one measured analyte.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need pesticide and species, edible egg proportion, pickling brine concentration and shell-free basis.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need pesticide and species, edible egg proportion, pickling brine concentration and shell-free basis.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Name each pesticide and residue definition, actual commodity, validated GC-MS or LC-MS method and individual MRL; broad 'pesticide residues' is not one measured analyte.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Dried glucose syrup is powdered, at least 93% solids and at most 1.0% sulphated ash.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Do not apply a comparator expressly requiring >1% sulphated ash to conforming dried glucose syrup.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain batch identity, DE/reducing sugar, actual sulphated ash and signed exact CTR commodity review.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need dried DE value, sulphated ash % and finished state; high-ash article only if actual ash criterion and category satisfied.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Do not apply a comparator expressly requiring >1% sulphated ash to conforming dried glucose syrup.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain batch identity, DE/reducing sugar, actual sulphated ash and signed exact CTR commodity review.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Edible lactose is whey-derived disaccharide, at least 99% lactose on dry basis and at most 0.3% sulphated ash.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Purified edible lactose is not automatically whole/dehydrated milk for lead CTR.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain whey origin, lactose assay, ash, physical form and current milk-product scope adjudication.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need pure lactose ingredient identity, purity and legal classification; milk-derived chemical not automatically dehydrated milk.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Purified edible lactose is not automatically whole/dehydrated milk for lead CTR.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain whey origin, lactose assay, ash, physical form and current milk-product scope adjudication.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Misri is candy from sugar or palmyrah juice and has total ash no more than 0.4%.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Total ash is not sulphated ash; misri is not automatically the refined sugar chromium article.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain commercial source, manufacturing method, total versus sulphated ash and signed refined-sugar applicability.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need crystal sugar origin, refined/pressed vs rock sugar identity and tested ash; chromium row names refined sugar.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Total ash is not sulphated ash; misri is not automatically the refined sugar chromium article.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain commercial source, manufacturing method, total versus sulphated ash and signed refined-sugar applicability.

case_dossiers.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Colostrum from cow/buffalo is separately defined as secretion occurring in the first days after parturition; a separate colostrum-products standard exists.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Colostrum and formulated colostrum powder are not automatically regular fluid milk or ordinary milk powders for lead.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Get cow/buffalo source, initial composition, drying ratio, carrier and product category/label.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need colostrum source, pure vs formulated concentrate and dehydration factor, distinct from ordinary milk.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Colostrum and formulated colostrum powder are not automatically regular fluid milk or ordinary milk powders for lead.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Get cow/buffalo source, initial composition, drying ratio, carrier and product category/label.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need honey vs royal jelly classification, drug chemical and bee-production evidence; animal tissue/honey mapping conditional.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need honey vs royal jelly classification, drug chemical and bee-production evidence; animal tissue/honey mapping conditional.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Royal jelly is not automatically honey; name the antibiotic compound, actual bee-source matrix and species-specific residue method and legal scope.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Food-grade silver leaf is sheet-form silver of at least 999/1000 fineness, at most 2.8 g/m², and excludes animal-origin manufacturing materials.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Purity of silver foil is a PRODUCT quality criterion, not a direct legal lead limit for finished leaf.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Get purity certificate, material origin/manufacture, lot metallic assay and applicable CTR metal row.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need actual edible silver foil substance purity and current distinct FSSR metal spec; fallback foods not specified not automatic.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Purity of silver foil is a PRODUCT quality criterion, not a direct legal lead limit for finished leaf.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Get purity certificate, material origin/manufacture, lot metallic assay and applicable CTR metal row.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need approved Ayurveda Aahara product identity, coconut/milk recipe and real marketed form; classical recipe not milk article.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need approved Ayurveda Aahara product identity, coconut/milk recipe and real marketed form; classical recipe not milk article.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Prove real coconut/milk recipe and fat %, sample basis, correct matrix method, regulatory article and licensing; an official recipe does not validate method or commercial formulation.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need buffalo milk, aromatic flower, sugar/water composition and licencing; dairy content alone is not finished milk article.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Need buffalo milk, aromatic flower, sugar/water composition and licencing; dairy content alone is not finished milk article.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Buffalo milk and flower infusion require actual batch formula, botanical identity, fat %, method validation and dry/fresh reporting basis; ordinary milk limits are not automatically assigned.

identity_primary_clauses.primary_identity_finding: Dextrin-soluble dietary fibre is specifically defined as purified polymer from dextrinification of starch, distinct from conventional maltodextrin.
identity_primary_clauses.false_ctr_analogy_to_block: Functional dietary fibre is not automatically solid glucose/high-ash sugar for lead CTR.
identity_primary_clauses.real_sample_evidence_needed: Obtain polymer identity, DP/chemical structure, starch source and finished product form.

case_dossiers.existing_legal_question: Need actual fibre dextrin chemical identity vs solid glucose, ash %, purity and exact finished ingredient.
case_dossiers.remaining_nontransfer_scope: Functional dietary fibre is not automatically solid glucose/high-ash sugar for lead CTR.
case_dossiers.evidence_required: Obtain polymer identity, DP/chemical structure, starch source and finished product form.
